name: api_request_latency
description: Distribution of Cloud Run request latency (seconds) for matrimonial-backend, EXCLUDING long-lived streaming endpoints (/socket.io, /messages/stream). Use this for true API p95 latency instead of run.googleapis.com/request_latencies, which counts streaming connection lifetime as latency.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="__BACKEND_SERVICE__" AND log_id("run.googleapis.com/requests") AND httpRequest.requestUrl !~ "/socket.io" AND httpRequest.requestUrl !~ "/messages/stream"
